summary.zh: 提供程序主要的下载页面。禁用或移除后，第三方下载类型可能没有可用操作入口；其他插件独立提供的已有下载计划仍可运行，依赖本插件来源的计划（包括 Pixiv 小说计划）会暂停。
summary.en: Provides the application's main download pages. Disabling or removing this plugin may leave no interface for third-party download types. Existing schedules provided independently by other plugins can continue to run; schedules that depend on this plugin's sources, including Pixiv novel schedules, will be suspended.

description.zh: 可选下载工作台插件，提供主要下载页面、插画下载与状态、Pixiv 计划来源及配套油猴脚本。通用队列控制、计划调度和脚本分发由主程序提供。停用或移除后，第三方下载类型可能没有可用操作入口；其他插件独立提供的已有计划仍可运行，依赖本插件来源或执行器的计划（包括 Pixiv 小说计划）会暂停。停用保留已有数据，完整重启后生效。
description.en: Optional download workbench plugin providing the main download pages, illustration downloads and status, Pixiv schedule sources, and companion userscripts. The main application provides generic queue control, scheduling, and userscript distribution. Disabling or removing this plugin may leave no interface for third-party download types. Existing schedules provided independently by other plugins can continue to run; schedules that depend on this plugin's sources or executors, including Pixiv novel schedules, will be suspended. Disabling it preserves existing data and takes effect after a full restart.

changeNotes: 下载工作台支持按需停用

summary.zh: 使用本地文件保存应用和插件的数据，切换数据库需要完全重启程序。
summary.en: Store application and plugin data in local files. Database changes require a full application restart.

description.zh: 提供宿主与 owner 隔离的私有 SQLite 存储，默认随发行包安装。选择、停用或替换后须完整重启；切换配置不迁移数据。
description.en: Provides SQLite storage for the host and isolated plugin owners. Installed by default. Selection, disabling or replacement requires a full restart; configuration changes do not migrate data.

changeNotes: 以外置数据库插件提供 SQLite 连接

summary.zh: 提供按需选择的 Compose Multiplatform 桌面界面与完整声明式 UI 节点渲染器。
summary.en: Provides an optional Compose Multiplatform desktop UI and a complete declarative UI node renderer.

description.zh: 提供默认的 Compose Multiplatform 桌面界面，也可通过 app.gui-provider=gui-compose 显式选择。
description.en: Provides the default Compose Multiplatform desktop UI. You can also select it explicitly with app.gui-provider=gui-compose.

changeNotes: 新增 Compose Multiplatform 桌面 UI 提供者

summary.zh: 提供完整 Swing 桌面界面、系统主题与浅色、深色、月光主题。
summary.en: Provides the complete Swing desktop UI plus system, light, dark, and moonlight themes.

description.zh: 为桌面 GUI 提供跟随系统、浅色、深色与 Moonlight 主题，并在完整重启后应用启动期主题。
description.en: Adds system, light, dark, and Moonlight themes to the desktop GUI, applied during startup after a full restart.

changeNotes: 首个外置版本

summary.zh: 提供下载统计与疑似重复检测工具（仅管理员）。
summary.en: Provides download statistics and likely-duplicate detection tools (admin only).

description.zh: 提供管理员专属的下载统计仪表盘与疑似重复作品检测、扫描及 Hash 回填工具。
description.en: Provides admin-only download statistics plus likely-duplicate detection, scanning, and hash backfill tools.

changeNotes: 首个外置版本

summary.zh: 为其它插件提供由调用方配置的隔离 PostHog 调查客户端。
summary.en: Provides caller-configured isolated PostHog survey clients for other plugins.

description.zh: 提供官方 PostHog 浏览器 SDK 与隔离的命名调查客户端；调查发布插件自持并传入项目参数与调查语义。
description.en: Provides the official PostHog browser SDK and isolated named survey clients; survey-publishing plugins own and pass their project parameters and survey semantics.

changeNotes: 首个外置版本

summary.zh: 浏览、搜索、管理已下载的插画作品，包含作品详情、精选集与系列页面。
summary.en: Browse, search and manage downloaded illustrations, including artwork detail, showcase and series pages.

description.zh: 提供本地画廊、作品详情、精选集与系列页面，基于核心下载事实和 Pixiv 元数据展示历史作品。
description.en: Provides the local gallery, artwork detail, showcase, and series pages backed by core download facts and Pixiv metadata.

changeNotes: 首个外置版本

summary.zh: 浏览与阅读已下载的小说，支持系列合订、翻译与听书朗读。
summary.en: Browse and read downloaded novels, with series bundling, translation and read-aloud.

description.zh: 提供小说下载、Pixiv 小说 API、计划任务小说执行、翻译、合订、AI 听书协作、小说画廊与阅读页。
description.en: Provides novel downloading, Pixiv novel APIs, scheduled novel execution, translation, merge, AI narration collaboration, the novel gallery, and the reader page.

changeNotes: 合并小说下载核心与小说展示层为官方可选插件

summary.zh: 通知场景、级别与管理员站内信。
summary.en: Notification scenarios, severity, and the administrator inbox.

description.zh: 提供通知场景开关、中性通知级别与管理员站内信；邮件和推送插件依赖它共享通知语义。
description.en: Provides notification scenario toggles, neutral severity, and the administrator inbox; mail and push plugins depend on it for shared notification semantics.

changeNotes: 新增管理员站内信入口、分类消息与详情页

summary.zh: 通过管理员站内信收集是否保留多人模式的意见。
summary.en: Collects feedback on whether multi-user mode should be retained through the administrator inbox.

description.zh: 通过管理员站内信收集多人模式保留意愿；调查参数与问卷语义由本插件自持。
description.en: Collects feedback on retaining multi-user mode through the administrator inbox; this plugin owns the survey parameters and semantics.

changeNotes: 新增多人模式去留调查站内信

summary.zh: 计划任务告警使用的多通道推送通知。
summary.en: Push notification channels for scheduled task alerts.

description.zh: 提供 Webhook、Telegram、Server 酱、PushPlus、企业微信、飞书、钉钉、Bark 等推送渠道。
description.en: Adds Webhook, Telegram, ServerChan, PushPlus, WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, and Bark push channels.

changeNotes: 首个外置版本

summary.zh: SMTP 邮件通知发送与模板。
summary.en: SMTP mail notification delivery and templates.

description.zh: 提供 SMTP 邮件通知发送、服务商预设、测试邮件与计划任务通知模板。
description.en: Adds SMTP mail delivery, provider presets, test mail, and scheduled-task notification templates.

changeNotes: 首个外置版本

summary.zh: 在线 TTS 与小说朗读语音引擎。
summary.en: Online TTS and narration voice engines.

description.zh: 提供 Edge TTS 听书入口，以及 VoxCPM、MiMo、CosyVoice、Fish Audio、MiniMax、ElevenLabs、Qwen、Doubao 等朗读引擎。
description.en: Adds the Edge TTS listening entry and narration engines including VoxCPM, MiMo, CosyVoice, Fish Audio, MiniMax, ElevenLabs, Qwen, and Doubao.

changeNotes: 首个外置版本

summary.zh: 提供 OpenAI 兼容模型的凭证、配置与调用能力。
summary.en: Provides credentials, configuration and access to OpenAI-compatible models.

description.zh: 统一管理 OpenAI 兼容模型的连接、凭证与配置，为翻译、朗读脚本等业务提供模型调用能力。
description.en: Manages connections, credentials and settings for OpenAI-compatible models used by translation and narration script features.

changeNotes: 翻译界面与任务迁入独立翻译插件

summary.zh: 使用 AI、有道或本机 LibreTranslate 服务翻译小说。
summary.en: Translate novels with AI, Youdao or a local LibreTranslate service.

description.zh: 提供小说手动和自动翻译，支持 AI 模型、有道文本翻译 API，以及用户部署的 LibreTranslate 服务。本地服务和模型需自行准备。
description.en: Provides manual and automatic novel translation using AI models, the Youdao text translation API or a user-managed LibreTranslate service. Local services and models must be installed separately.

changeNotes: 翻译功能独立为插件，新增有道与 LibreTranslate 引擎

summary.zh: 为小说与翻译插件提供内容和任务接口。
summary.en: Content and task interfaces shared by novel and translation plugins.

description.zh: 提供小说数据与翻译服务之间的共享契约类型，由依赖它的插件自动安装。
description.en: Provides shared contract types for novel data and translation services, installed as a dependency of the plugins that use it.

changeNotes: 新增小说翻译契约

summary.zh: 拖拽组件，编辑页面布局并发布。
summary.en: Arrange components, edit page layouts and publish.

description.zh: 通过拖拽组件编辑页面布局、样式和属性，保存草稿并发布或恢复上一版。组件由独立插件贡献，登录页面保留原认证表单与默认外观恢复入口。
description.en: Drag components to edit page layout, styles and properties. Save drafts, publish, or restore the previous publication. Independent plugins contribute components; the login page retains its authentication form and default appearance recovery.

changeNotes: 新增可视化页面编辑、插件组件与发布恢复

summary.zh: 在线与本地验证码，支持计算验证、字符输入和滑块拼图
summary.en: Online and local CAPTCHA with proof of work, character entry and slider puzzles

description.zh: 官方可选验证码插件，提供 Turnstile、reCAPTCHA v2 在线验证，以及 ALTCHA SHA-256、ALTCHA PBKDF2、字符输入和滑块拼图离线组件。拖入兼容表单并发布后由后端强制验证。首次启用自动生成并加密保存离线签名密钥；在线验证须配置站点凭据。普通发行包不预装，离线全量包包含。
description.en: Optional official CAPTCHA plugin with Turnstile and reCAPTCHA v2 online verification, plus ALTCHA SHA-256, ALTCHA PBKDF2, text input and slider puzzle offline components. Bind a compatible form and publish to enforce verification on the server. The local signing key is generated and encrypted on first activation; online verification requires site credentials. Standard distributions do not preinstall it; the full offline bundle includes it.

changeNotes: 提供可绑定表单的在线与离线验证码

summary.zh: 连接 PostgreSQL 服务器，保存应用和插件的数据。切换数据库需要完全重启程序。
summary.en: Store application and plugin data on a PostgreSQL server. Database changes require a full application restart.

description.zh: 支持 PostgreSQL 17 / 18（UTF8），为私有存储创建独立受限角色与 schema。须配置具备所需管理权限的连接，安装后须完整重启。切换数据库请在设置页检查并确认迁移；直接修改连接配置不会迁移数据。
description.en: Supports PostgreSQL 17 and 18 with UTF8 and creates restricted roles and schemas for private storage. Requires connection credentials with the necessary management privileges and a full restart after installation. To switch databases, check and confirm migration in Settings; editing the connection configuration directly does not migrate data.

changeNotes: 以外置数据库插件提供 PostgreSQL 连接

summary.zh: 直接读取浏览器中的 PixivBatchDownloader 下载历史，也可从桌面导入历史文件或自动采集新下载，保留原文件。
summary.en: Read PixivBatchDownloader history directly from the browser, import history files from the desktop, or automatically collect new downloads. Original files are retained.

description.zh: 官方可选插件，普通发行包不预装，离线全量包包含。安装插件后须完全退出并重新启动本程序。在单人模式下安装下载页提供的油猴脚本，配置一次同机下载目录并重启后端，即可自动将 PixivBatchDownloader 后续下载完成的插画、漫画、动图和小说导入对应画廊。直接读取原文件，不复制；删除画廊记录也保留原文件。不扫描历史下载。
description.en: Optional official plugin, available from the plugin market and included in the full offline bundle. Standard distributions do not preinstall it. Fully exit and restart the app after installing the plugin. In single-user mode, install the userscript from the download page, configure the download folder on the same machine, and restart the backend. Subsequent illustrations, manga, animations, and novels completed by PixivBatchDownloader are automatically imported into their galleries. Original files are referenced without copying and kept when gallery records are deleted. Existing downloads are not scanned.

changeNotes: 新增 PixivBatchDownloader 导入支持，自动导入后续下载完成的插画、漫画、动图和小说，保留原文件
